title: DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit for eDNA Analysis of Shrimp Stomach Contents
author: Celine Richard
materials: Preheat Buffer AE at 56°C before adding in.

steps.title: Prepare buffers and reagents
steps.instruction: Perform all centrifugation steps at room temperature (15‑25 °C). Redissolve any precipitates in Buffer AL and Buffer ATL; if needed warm them to 56 °C for 5 min until clear. Premix Buffer AL with ethanol before use (add 90 ml EtOH to 86 ml Buffer AL or 260 ml EtOH to 247 ml Buffer AL, shake thoroughly and mark the bottle). Add ethanol to Buffer AW1 and Buffer AW2 concentrates and mark the bottles. Mix Buffer AW1 by inverting several times before use.

steps.title: Equilibrate tissue and preheat incubator
steps.instruction: Allow frozen tissue or cell pellets to equilibrate to room temperature. Preheat an incubator to 56 °C.

steps.title: Lyse tissue with ATL and proteinase K
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.025 g (25 mg) rodent tail tissue. Add 180 µl Buffer ATL, then add 20 µl proteinase K. Vortex to mix and incubate at 56 °C overnight until completely lysed, vortexing periodically during incubation and vortex for 15 seconds immediately before the next step.

steps.title: Add AL buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl Buffer AL to the lysate, vortex immediately, then incubate at 56 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add ethanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl 100 % ethanol to the sample and mix thoroughly by vortexing.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column
steps.instruction: Pipet the entire mixture into a DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube. Centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 1 minute at room temperature (15‑25 °C). Discard the flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube, add 500 µl Buffer AW1, and centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 1 minute at room temperature. Discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in another new 2 ml collection tube, add 500 µl Buffer AW2, and centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature. Discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Transfer column to clean tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a fresh 1.5 ml or 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer AE
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Buffer AE to the center of the spin‑column membrane, incubate for 1 minute at room temperature (15‑25 °C), then centrifuge at 6 000 × g for 1 minute to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Optional second elution
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution step to increase DNA yield, collecting the second eluate in a separate microcentrifuge tube.
